outputs.name: page_rank
outputs.basis: the metric of upstream Verify (isnan(page_rank_[i]) or fabs(page_rank_[i] - cpu_page_rank[i]) > cpu_page_rank[i] / 1000, common/pr_benchmark.cc:119-120, i.e. max |a - c| / c) with the tolerance 3e-5 instead of 1e-3, minus the B200 output's own deviation from the CPU reference (a NaN fails). Measured 2026-10-28: legitimate implementations (fmad off, 4/8/32 lanes per row with shuffle trees, merge-style nonzero chunks and push atomics, cuSPARSE CSR ALG1/ALG2, reverse / 4-accumulator / Kahan / f64 accumulation, f64 vectors, block sizes) <= 1.4e-6; a vector stored in f16 / bf16 6.2e-4 / 4.5e-3 and matrix values rounded to f16 / bf16 / tf32 >= 6.7e-2 fail
